languages._comment: Override or add language packs here. Keys: months, months_short, present, date_month_year, date_long, documents, filenames, labels, apply_labels (link texts that lead to the form). See jobapply/i18n.py for the built-in de/en packs.

_comment_style: Look of the PDFs: classic (thin rules, monochrome), bar (HSG-style coloured heading bars, dates right), bare (ETH-style unlabelled personal line, small caps), accent (classic with the accent colour). Per application: "style" in application.json. letter_style (here or per application) gives the cover letter its own Style, e.g. classic for a plain black letter next to a bar CV. accent is the one colour bar/accent use.
_comment_operator: The program `jobapply run` starts at the letter step when you press [a] (docs/adr/0004). {skill} and {slug} name the skill and the Application, {tool} is the checkout holding .agents/skills. Keep the prompt before --allowedTools (it is variadic). "" disables it; then run the skills in your agent yourself.
_comment_editor: Command `jobapply open` and the [e] key in `run` use to open a file, e.g. "code -r" for VS Code.
_comment_profile_fields: Swiss convention (docs/adr/0003). Dotted paths into profile.json: required fields block `render`; recommended ones only warn. Edit for another country.
_comment_home_country: Spellings of your own country; the cover letter omits the country line when the employer's address matches one.
